plugins.name: Contrôle des titres de transport
plugins.author: AlexLiveFrr
plugins.description: Some passengers board without a ticket. Check them at a stop, collect fines, keep the cash desk and get a report at the end of the duty.

plugins.name: Diagnostic de mods
plugins.author: AlexLiveFrr
plugins.description: Checks the loaded map, bus, HOF, tickets and timetable for common mod problems, notes slow tiles, crashes at a standstill and roads without lanes, and writes a report file for bug reports. Nothing is sent anywhere.

plugins.name: Enregistreur de trajets
plugins.author: AlexLiveFrr
plugins.description: Records every trip (route, speed, delay, stops, crashes) to JSON and a text summary you can share, keeps best times, and draws a recorded trip on the road as a speed-coloured trace. Files stay on your computer.

plugins.name: Prise de service réaliste
plugins.author: AlexLiveFrr
plugins.description: A depot checklist before you leave (brake, electrics, engine, air pressure, lights, indicator and horn test, destination, doors) and a parking checklist at the end of the duty.

plugins.name: Speed warning
plugins.author: openOMSI
plugins.description: Shows a message while the bus is faster than a limit you choose. A small example of a catalog plugin with settings.
